verses.1: And they sailed across the sea, along the coast of Sea of Galilee, just as Jehovah had commanded me. They traveled along the coast for many days.
verses.2: And the LORD said to me, “It is so.”
verses.3: Rab Lakum, this mountain has been turned upside down. Now, you see a view in front of you.
verses.4: And he commanded the people, “You shall not pass through the border of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who dwell in Seir. They will be afraid of you, and you shall be safe from them.”
verses.5: Do not be afraid of them, for I will not give you land from here to the other side of the foot of the mountain. For this is a place that I have given over to you as a gift.
verses.6: You will be given food in exchange for money. You will also be given water in exchange for money, and you can drink it.
verses.7: For Jehovah your God will bless you in all your efforts. He will guide you through this great journey. For forty years, Jehovah your God will be with you; you will never lack anything.
verses.8: And we pass by our brother Esau, who lives in Seir, along the road from Elat and Ezer-Gavar. Then we continue along the road through the desert of Moab.
verses.9: And the LORD said to me, “Do not attack them or fight against them. I will not give you any land as a possession. For I have given to Lot the city of Jericho as a possession.”
verses.10: In the front, there will sit a great and numerous people, like giants.
verses.11: Even those who heal can be considered monsters. And those who suffer can be called “gods”.
verses.12: And in She’ir, the Horim will dwell inside. And sons of Esau will inherit them. They will destroy them from their midst. They will be placed under their control, just as Israel did with the land that Jehovah gave to them.
verses.13: Now, get up and cross over the river Zared. We will cross over the river Zared as well.
verses.14: And those days when we walked from the Holy Land, across the river Zerad, for thirty-five years. All those years passed until the end of that era. The people who fought along with them were those who followed God’s commands.
verses.15: And the hand of Jehovah was also upon them, from near the camp all the way to their deaths.
verses.16: And when all the soldiers died, they were killed right in front of the people.
verses.17: And the LORD spoke to me, saying:
verses.18: You will cross today the border of Moab, and enter the city.
verses.19: And you came before the children of Amun, so that they would not be harmed or offended by you. For I will not give the land of the children of Amun to you as inheritance. It has already been given to the children of Lot as inheritance.
verses.20: This is a land of healing. Even those who are sick will be healed and dwell there. The people will call them “healers.”
verses.21: A great and numerous people, like giants. Jehovah destroyed them from their midst, and they became slaves to Him.
verses.22: When Boaz’s sons lived in those houses that he had destroyed, and they settled down there until today.
verses.23: And those who sat in the courtyards until Azah, like threads that come from a thread, they destroyed them and sat down beneath them.
verses.24: Come, go, and cross the river Arnon. See, I have given you Sihon, king of the Amorites, and his land, which was desolate and plundered by war.
verses.25: Today, may your fear and dread be removed from before the nations under all the heavens. May they listen to your voice, and may they not be troubled or sickened at your presence.
verses.26: And I will send servants from the East to Sihon, king of the Amorites. I will speak words of peace to him.
verses.27: I will pass through your land along the path that I am going. I will not go to the right or left.
verses.28: “Food in silver will satisfy me; I will eat it. Water in silver will be given to me; I will drink it. But I will still walk on my feet.”
verses.29: When the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, and those who live in Edom, cross the Jordan into the land that Jehovah our God will give us.
verses.30: And I did not know that King Hezekiah would pass by us. It was difficult for God, your God, to control his spirit, and he had to give up his heart, so that it might be in your hands today.
verses.31: And the LORD said to me, “See, I will make Sihon and his land a subject to you. He will be a subject to your rule.”
verses.32: And Sihon went out to meet us, along with all his people, to fight against us.
verses.33: And Jehovah our God will give it to us in our hands. And you shall take it, along with its children and all its people.
verses.34: And they destroyed all their cities at that time. They killed all the men, women, and children in those cities. Not a single survivor was left.
verses.35: Only the cows gave us food, and they also provided us with the provisions needed for our survival.
verses.36: From the valley of Arnon, and from the city that lies in that valley, until Gilad, there was no kingdom. But Jehovah our God gave us all these lands right before our eyes.
verses.37: Only to the land of the children of Ammon did not You bring down any hand of the river Yavok, nor the cities of the mountains, nor everything that Yahweh, our God, commanded us.
